summary: Eleven hour weather delay leaving Denver, meals paid in cash
story: My husband Ben and I were flying from Denver to Reykjavik on August 21. Thunderstorms shut down departures and our 2:10 pm flight finally left at 1:15 the next morning. We took a room at the airport hotel for the evening so we could rest, and I have that receipt. We also bought lunch, dinner and a lot of coffee at various kiosks around the terminal, about $96 in total, but we paid cash and did not keep the receipts. I hope that is not a problem.
